facts.business: Shalibhadra Finance Limited is a non-banking financial company (NBFC) focused on vehicle loans and serving difficult-to-reach rural areas across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, and Rajasthan through a network of 62 branches.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Company is considering expansion into the state of Goa & Karnataka in FY 25-26

auditor.name: M/s. Vora & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Title deeds of immovable properties are in the process of transfer in the name of the Company; Income Tax demand of Rs. 7.39 Crores outstanding for AY 2017-18 pending appeal with CIT(A)

key_risks: Geographic concentration risk (operations in 4 states, 49 districts)
Regulatory risk (capital adequacy requirement of 15% vs maintained 78.28%)
Tax litigation risk (Income Tax dispute of Rs. 7.39 Crores for AY 2017-18)
Asset quality risk in vehicle loan portfolio
Dependence on rural/semi-urban markets with difficult-to-reach customer segments
facts.related_party_note: Loan to employee of Rs. 98 lakhs outstanding as at balance sheet date; Investments made in companies and unsecured loans granted to companies and other parties (details not fully specified in excerpts)
